author: codex-thread:01a1d223-7797-7df0-89d2-d8161a4ecb9b
scope: Code-only preservation and regression review. No source-content, attribution, chronology, identity, chapter-completion or publication approval.
summary: The change narrowly extends existing no-span preservation to exact-target incoming family claims with an unchanged Chinese kinship witness, without weakening owned-claim evidence requirements. No open code findings remain. The corrected patch reproduces both sealed modules from the released baseline.

findings.title: Original patch used invalid symlink/deletion framing
findings.detail: The original sealed patch described a released mode-100644 module as a mode-120000 deletion against b/dev/stdin followed by full-file creation. It was not a usable minimal patch against the released baseline.
findings.resolution: Superseded by sealed incoming-kinship-retention-v2.patch. Independent in-memory hunk application verified every source/context line and reconstructed exactly the two sealed module hashes; original malformed patch remains evidence.

preservationChecks.incomingGuard: person.localId and claim.subject must be strings; subject differs from target; predicate is family-relationship; value.personId equals that exact localId; every nonempty incoming evidence list resolves in both packets with unchanged Chinese; the nonempty Chinese kinship term occurs in its cited current Chinese witness.
preservationChecks.ownedGuard: Every owned claim still requires nonempty evidence with all Chinese witnesses present and unchanged; incoming support cannot excuse missing or changed owned witnesses.

testsRun.name: Sealed input verification
testsRun.detail: All five original order file hashes, all five v2 order file hashes, six nested work-order evidence seals, and both released Git blob IDs matched. The v2 order links the original order SHA256.

testsRun.name: Released-baseline module diff
testsRun.detail: Independently compared git-show bytes at released master against both sealed modules; only the incoming-kinship helper/callsite and related self-test additions changed.

testsRun.name: Loader-based retention regression
testsRun.detail: Existing own-name/own-kinship cases and new exact-target, wrong-target, non-family, self-directed, English-only, absent-term, missing/empty evidence, changed-source and absent-exception cases passed; integrated unsupported-person removal left no dangling family links.

testsRun.name: Actual Jinshu 119 native preview, in memory
testsRun.detail: Used the existing canonical-runtime native helpers with import paths and helper exports exposed only in memory; overlaid the sealed corrected library through test-loader. Original extraction passed initial native validation; native reviewed repairs and candidate handling were reused. Separately loaded exact released git-show library bytes for baseline comparison. No files were written.

testsRun.name: Native chronology gate
testsRun.detail: After native resolution of all 121 candidates, validatePeopleExtraction rejected exactly four existing p190 chronology requirements: active-date hint, evidence-backed attestation, Western active-date hint and Western-year attestation. No suppression or invented dates occurred.

testsRun.name: Input immutability during native preview
testsRun.detail: Before/after SHA256 comparison showed unchanged canonical chapter, canonical extraction, primary Git index, sealed candidate.compact.json and validated-review.json.

testsRun.name: V2 patch reconstruction
testsRun.detail: Read-only in-memory application of two hunks per file against exact released git-show bytes checked hunk positions, context, removal/addition counts, file scope and resulting bytes. Both outputs exactly matched sealed module hashes. An initial checker rejected standard diff --git headers before processing any hunk; the corrected checker handled those headers and passed.

testsRun.name: Resource guard
testsRun.detail: Immediate pre-review and pre-write guards passed. A mid-review disk measurement failed at 29.8984375 GiB, with normal memory pressure and no swap warning. A following no-write native preview was inadvertently launched without conditioning on guard success; it was allowed to finish. New tests/writes were then held. Host reported completed-artifact cleanup, and subsequent independent guards passed, including 30.189453125 GiB before final patch reconstruction.

limitations: Approval covers code preservation behavior only. It does not endorse mother attribution, kinship content, translation text or p190 chronology; those remain subject to independent content review and normal gates.

Native integration used the existing canonical-runtime dependency scripts, whose runtime revision differs from released master; the changed library was overlaid from the sealed artifact and the baseline comparison used exact released Git bytes. Full released-site build and broader applier self-tests were not run by this reviewer.
Patch applicability was independently verified by exact read-only hunk reconstruction in memory, without changing a checkout or index.
No queue changes, branch changes, staging, commits, builds, secondary checkouts, copies, canonical writes or subagents were performed. This JSON is the sole file written by this reviewer.
